bedeken-licence.caption: The New York marriage licence is signed.

bedeken-veiling.caption: The groom lowers the veil over the bride's face.

chuppah-blessings.caption: Seven blessings over a cup of wine, each sung by a different guest.

chuppah-circling.caption: She circles him three times, he circles her three times, then once together.

chuppah-glass.caption: A glass is broken. Everyone shouts 'mazel tov'.

chuppah-ketubah.caption: The ketubah is read aloud and handed over.

chuppah-rings.caption: The rings go on the index finger, not the ring finger, during the ceremony: all witnesses must plainly see it go on.

hora-band.caption: The divider comes down and everyone dances together.

hora-mechitza.caption: Two circles: men on one side, women on the other.

hora-performance.caption: Guests entertain the couple: juggling, cartwheels, whatever they can do.

hora-shtick.caption: The couple are lifted on chairs.

kabalat-panim.caption: Food and drinks while everyone arrives.

rikudim-dj.caption: The second set: songs you already know.

seuda.caption: Find your table. Dinner comes in courses.

tisch-ketubah.caption: The ketubah, the marriage contract, is signed by two witnesses.

tisch-singing.caption: The groom's table: singing, toasts, a few words of Torah.

yichud.caption: The couple spend a few minutes alone.
